record.label: Benefit entitlement in the captured custody guidance
record.scope: Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.
record.text: Entitlement and payability are distinct in the captured guidance, but entitlement can end under benefit-specific conditions. DMG 24185–24186, 24212, 41823 and 54214 show why a payment-only statement cannot be generalised across JSA, IS and ESA. A nil Pension Credit award must be described using its own credit/award wording, not inferred from 12003.

record.label: Benefit payability in the captured custody guidance
record.scope: Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.
record.text: Payability concerns whether benefit is paid or withheld. In 12003 it is explicitly distinct from entitlement for the benefits listed in 12002; benefit-specific chapters use different availability, applicable-amount, disqualification and suspension mechanisms. No equivalence between a nil payment and retained entitlement is asserted.

record.label: ESA custody regime distinction
record.scope: Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.
record.text: The unqualified label ESA does not choose a component or contemporary regime. For the captured DMG legacy comparison, 12015 routes ESA(Cont) to Chapter 53 and ESA(IR) to Chapter 54; both must be considered where both apply (54215/42582). New Style ESA instead routes to ADM U6 under 12016, whose body is outside this profile.

record.label: Income Support prisoner applicable amount
record.scope: Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.
record.text: Captured DMG 24212 gives a nil applicable amount for the sentenced-prisoner branch of 24197(1) and explicitly says a claimant with a nil applicable amount is not entitled. DMG 24214 allows possible remand entitlement with allowable housing costs, otherwise nil. Definitions, detention dates, hospital legislation and partner treatment must be read separately; prisoner here includes a sentence by a criminal, civil or military court.

record.label: Legacy JSA availability during custody
record.scope: Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.
record.text: In captured DMG 24185–24186, custody or temporary release prevents the availability condition and the person is not entitled to legacy JSA(Cont) or JSA(IB). This is an entitlement-condition mechanism, not a universal payment-only suspension. DMG 24187 has a limited availability treatment for specified custody for a maximum of 96 hours before release, so long as the person is not a prisoner. The old suggestions about IS/partner claims and Memo 07/20 are historical source context, not current application advice.

record.label: State Pension Credit prisoner credit rates
record.scope: Frozen DMG research: listed legacy JSA(Cont), JSA(IB), IS, SPC and ESA(Cont)/ESA(IR) imprisonment guidance captured on 15 September 2026. This is an explanation of the captured text, not a determination of contemporary individual eligibility.
record.text: Captured DMG 78666 describes guarantee credit as normally not payable because the standard minimum guarantee and additional amount rates are nil; 78667–78669 retain the remand definition, possible housing-cost addition for up to 52 weeks and excluded additions. Bail-hostel treatment differs under 78670–78671. DMG 78672 gives a nil maximum savings credit for prisoners, including remand prisoners. DMG 78675–78676 describe revising awards to nil and partner/change-of-claimant treatment. These amount and award mechanisms must not be replaced with an unqualified assertion that all Pension Credit entitlement survives custody or that every custody case has the same result.

limitations: Independent experimental research, not an official DWP document, benefits advice, a calculation or an individual entitlement decision. All authored meanings and dependencies require specialist review.

The broad labels JSA and ESA do not establish a claimant’s regime. This profile explains the listed DMG legacy regimes; New Style JSA/ESA, UC and PIP are routed to ADM by 12016. Those ADM bodies are not acquired. Ask for regime/date and fresh authoritative checks before applying guidance to a person.
The payability statement at 12003 is scoped by the list in 12002. It cannot replace benefit-specific rules or establish that entitlement always survives imprisonment.

Machine-extracted whole pages retain neighbouring text, partial unrelated paragraphs, footnotes, historical examples and possible reading-order errors. Use the stated locators; page presence is not full legal interpretation or PDF visual review.

Capture date is not publication, revision or commencement. Old amendment footers and example dates remain literal source text. The currently linked catalogue is not current-law assurance; legislation and case law have not been consolidated or reconciled.

The frozen PDFs still refer to Memo 07/20. Official catalogue history says it was removed because the regulations ceased to have effect from 31 August 2021. The memo body is absent; do not revive that temporary exception.

12016’s ADM M1 reference conflicts with the frozen catalogue title marking M1 spare. S1/U6 are identified routes, not acquired evidence. Internal Chapter 41 references to 53112 and 53071 and the printed Chapter 53 number 531261 remain unresolved version/typographic observations.

Prisoner definitions differ by benefit: do not transfer the general criminal/civil distinction indiscriminately. Remand, bail hostel, sentence, release, hospital legislation, fine default, overseas detention, time limits and partner circumstances require the relevant branch. Housing-cost passages do not establish a current housing award.
